dialogue.speaker: CLIENT

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Before we finish the dealing details, let me cover the product discussion. Meridian Asia Equity Fund is concentrated in Asian equity markets, so a regional economic downturn or adverse government policy changes can cause its underlying share prices and the fund's value to fall sharply. dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I understand. A downturn in Asian markets or adverse policy changes could drive down the underlying shares and sharply reduce the fund's value.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: You could lose some or all of the capital you invest in this fund. On the practical arrangements, is telephone contact still the most convenient way to reach you while you are travelling?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: It is. I often leave messages unread while I'm moving between meetings, whereas I can usually find somewhere quiet to return a call. If I miss you, please leave a message without the account details.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll note that contact preference. Has the change in your business responsibilities affected when you are generally available?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'm less involved in the warehouse now. My operations manager handles dispatch and the routine supplier queries, and I spend more time visiting customers. My diary is still settling down, so a fixed calling window wouldn't be very useful.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can leave the timing flexible and arrange a callback when necessary. That should avoid interrupting your customer meetings. We can now return to the remaining dealing detail.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Please place this as a market order. And for any follow-up conversation, please contact me directly rather than through the office. My staff manage the business diary, but I keep my personal banking separate.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I'll keep the contact arrangements separate from your office diary. I have the details ready for the final readback.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: There is something else I should mention before that. The subscription funds came from unrelated business associates who routed their receipts through my personal account to keep the beneficial owners out of their own banks' records.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction exactly as you have stated it, and I authorise you to submit it.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for your time, Adrian. I'll leave you to your meetings. If you need to speak with me again, you can call through the usual private-banking number.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: Thank you, Rachel. That's all I wanted to cover today. Goodbye.
